content: If the ASCII buffer returned in SWS_DoIP_00154 does not start with “DoIP - “ and the configuration parameter DoIPDhcpOptionVinUse is set to TRUE the DoIP module shall call the SoAd_WriteDhcpHostNameOption with a pointer to to the ASCII buffer “DoIP - VIN<vinnumberi nascii>“ with <vinnumberinascii> representing the ASCII representation of the VIN that is retrieved via Dcm_GetVin. If no valid VIN could be retrieved the DoIP shall use the configured DoIPVinInvalidityPattern in ASCII representation.
